title: Privacy Policy
body:
This policy explains what information NEXTDROP collects and how it is used.

### Who we are
[[TO COMPLETE: your trading name, and your registered company name and address if you have one]]

### What we collect
- **This website** does not use cookies, analytics or tracking scripts, and has no forms or accounts. Our web host may keep standard server logs (such as IP address and browser type) for security.
- **When you order by WhatsApp or Telegram**, we receive the details you send us: your name, delivery address, phone number or username, and the products you are ordering.

### How we use it
We use your details only to confirm, deliver and support your order, and to reply to your messages. We do not sell your information.

### Who we share it with
We share your name and address with our delivery courier to deliver your order. [[TO COMPLETE: payment providers you use]]

### How long we keep it
[[TO COMPLETE: e.g. order details are kept for 6 years for accounting purposes]]

### Your rights
Under UK GDPR you can ask to see, correct or delete your personal information. Message us to make a request. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).

Messages sent through WhatsApp and Telegram are also subject to those apps' own privacy policies.

*This is a starting template, not legal advice.*
